name: workflow
description: Minimal task-board framework for hobby/solo repos: groom, run (one task inline, many in isolated workers, or a free-text ask matched onto the board), decision log, cross-repo status, framework-init scaffolding, framework-doctor health check and guides wizard. Tasks are files in workflow/<status>/ folders (folder = status, moves are git mv), board view via a shipped ./workflow/status script; validation, docs, and commit rules come from the repo's own instructions.

interface.shortDescription: Folder-based task board and lifecycle for solo/hobby repos
interface.longDescription: A minimal work framework shared across repos. Tasks are single files in workflow/<status>/ folders — the folder IS the status, so every transition is one git mv. Ready is ordered by sparse priority lines; a shipped ./workflow/status script prints the board. The plugin ships the lifecycle only; how work is validated, documented, and committed comes from the repo's own AGENTS.md. Skills: groom refines a task into a spec, run implements one task inline, runs several in isolated workers, or takes a free-text ask and matches it onto the board, decision appends to the repo's decision log, status shows the board here or across repos, framework-init scaffolds a new repo, framework-doctor checks the board and offers the plugin's optional working guides for adoption.
defaultPrompt: Use $run to implement the top Ready task from the board.
